name: Solo · Stay a Little Longer
teacher: Ms. Brittany (solo rehearsals booked as needed, at least 2 a month; Hannah not available on a regular schedule)
rehearsal: Solo rehearsals with Ms. Brittany booked as needed (at least 2 a month) · Thu/Fri/Sun home practice
costume: Option 6 · Kellé Blossom Within — Leotard #5448A (lycra with ruched stretch-mesh wrap overlay, open crisscross back, organza flower appliqués you place yourself) + Draped Skirt #4518A (asymmetrical mesh, ruched front drape, longer back hem, attached lined trunks). Color: BLUSH for both. Leotard sized by girth; skirt by waist/hips.
music: Track is 2:04. Soft verse 0:00–0:48. Big swell at 0:48, full volume to 1:52. Fade 1:52–2:00, silent by 2:00. In the loud section a strong beat lands about every 2.3 seconds: finish every shape ON it.
map: 0:10.5 side-sit leg reach · 0:16.5 kneeling arch + leg kick · 0:31.5 heel stretch · 0:48 leap on the swell · 0:49.5 cartwheel · 1:07.75 walkover to knees (handstand → bridge → knees) · 1:18.25 donut roll on the mat · 1:28.5 handstand · 1:40.75 floor kick · 1:49.5 passé turns · 2:00.5 floor ending — hold until the music is gone
strengths: Floor work is smooth, no crashing in or out
Full-body reach on the lunge (arms past the body)
Committed acro: cartwheel, walkover to knees and handstand are clean
Straight standing leg in attitude and passé
corrections: Point the foot and keep the knee straight on the side-sit leg reach (0:10.5) and every floor extension, including on the way down.
Side extension: commit to a clean attitude or straighten it — no halfway
Eyes up: plan a focal point for every section, stop checking the mirror/Hannah
Long arms overhead, shoulders down
Passé: toe to the side of the knee, high relevé, sharp spot
Cartwheel prep should look like choreography, not a setup
#other Donut roll (1:18.25): arms down, head ALL the way back. Don't tuck the chin (Hannah).
Hold the final floor shape until 2:00 when the sound is fully gone
#knees Calypso: front leg straight and turned out, back knee high, land soft and keep moving
#timing Finish every shape ON the beat — count out loud, especially through the loud section
#feet Last leg lift before the ending: turn the leg out and point that foot hard (Hannah)
#knees First leg extension: take it all the way up before you open and fall (Hannah)
tricks: Side-sit leg reach (0:10.5): sit on one hip, hand on the floor, leg straight up to the ceiling: 4 counts up, hold 2, 4 down, 6 each side. Arm slides up the leg, fingers past the toes. Cue: push the floor, reach the toe; knee stays straight as the leg fans down.

Kneeling arch + leg kick (0:16.5): warm the back first (cobra, then seal). Kneel tall, arch, tip forward onto the hands and kick the back leg up, straight and pointed. 4 slow on the mat, knees over toes as you come back up.
Heel stretch (0:31.5): développé side at a counter: 4 up, hold 2, 4 down ×6. Side-lying leg lifts 2×12. Standing heel down. Decide with Ms. Brittany: clean attitude or straight leg, never halfway.
Leap + cartwheel (0:48 · 0:49.5): leap ON the swell, then cartwheel: reach, look, place. Head stays up until the hands go down. Cartwheel over a tape line, legs straight. Play from 0:44 ×5.

Walkover to knees (1:07.75: handstand → bridge → knees) + handstand (1:28.5): wrists first. Wall handstand 3×10–15 s. Kick up to vertical ×5, split at the top ×5. The landing knee touches softly, never drops. Kick-overs only with a spotter.
Floor kick (1:40.75): 8 slow kicks each side, 4 up, 4 down, pointed at the top. Kick from the hip, back long; hamstring stretch after.
Passé turns (1:49.5): passé balance on relevé 10 s. Quarter turns ×8, half ×8, singles ×10. Spot a sticker on the wall; arms round like holding a beach ball.
The ending (2:00.5): play the last 15 seconds of the real track ×5. Hold, breathe, count 8 more after you think it's over.

Donut roll (1:18.25): mat only. Warm the back first (cobra, then seal, 20 s). Kneeling backbend with hands to heels 3×5 s. Bridge holds 3×10 s. Then the donut shape: arms down, knees bent, chest open, head ALL the way back. Hannah's fix: don't tuck the chin. Practise on the mat, the way she set it. Cue: lead with the chest, eyes follow the feet.

Calypso: the entrance is step, prepare, chaîné, calypso — drill those four words out loud. Kick the front leg straight and turned out as you turn, back knee up and bent, chest lifted — 6 each way, then 4 to the music. Land softly and roll straight out of it, then stand all the way up.

Scorpion to needle: warm the back first (cobra, seal, 3×10s). At the barre or counter: hold a low scorpion 3×8s each side with hips square and the standing knee straight, then tilt forward toward needle only as far as it stays easy. Never pull past today's range; stop if the back pinches.

story: Someone you love is packing to leave. Ask them to stay one more minute.
performance: Character: she is alone, fighting to keep someone from walking away. Every reach is a plea.
Face — pleading & yearning: look past the judges with soft, open eyes and slightly parted lips, reaching for someone just out of touch.
Face — fragility: on the quiet lines let the breath drop, soften the brow, let the focus fall to the hands.
Musicality — rushing vs suspended: sharp, urgent movement for panic, then slow suspended floats to stop time.
Musicality — chorus swells (0:48 on): biggest extensions across the whole stage when the vocal opens up.
Stage presence: eye line all the way to the top back rows. Breathe audibly with the music on every jump and floor descent.
Secret: every time an arm reaches out, the fingertips hold an invisible thread tied to the person you love — pull so they won't slip away.

Counts 1 & 2, shoulder on 3, then 4, 5
Reach, reach — click, click
Roll ×4, down onto the elbow
Nose to knee, then look up

Reach — hands over the face — throw
Back out into the walkover — freeze, bend it, arch up (breathe)
Extension
Donut roll: arms down, head all the way back
Passé reach, then the other passé
Rond de jambe ×3, big reach
Tilt extension — bend it and fall
Come up and spin

checkpoints.text: Whole solo from memory, on the music
A full run with no missed steps, filmed for Ms. Brittany
Tricks start (the whole dance is from memory first)

pinned.text: Knee alignment: knees over toes in every plié, lunge, landing and floor entry.
Timing + memorize every step. Go over Hannah's two videos step by step until there's no question what comes next; then improve moves and tricks.

name: Trio · Enjoy the Silence
rehearsal: Choreography with Larisa · mark it once a week at home (Thursday) · trio with Hannah and Lauren
costume: The Line Up “Sophie” unitard — one each in Fossil (grey), Stone (muddy grey-brown) and Black; the deep V in front gets stoned in the matching color. Made to order, no re-order: measure Sofia with the Line Up size guide and send Larisa the size.
music: Final cut is 2:24. The music itself ends at 2:13 and the last 11 seconds are SILENT — hold the final picture until 2:24. Builds steadily from the start: pulses at ~0:22, a big hit at 0:30 (the loudest moment of the first half), ~0:44 and ~0:58. The sound opens up at 1:06, breathes at 1:12–1:17 and 1:23–1:30, then runs full-out from 1:36 to the end. 86 BPM, a slow half-time feel (the pulse ticks at 172).
map: Kneeling line → floor phrase with all three legs up (~0:12) → rolls (~0:19–0:24) → 0:30 big hit (freeze together) → kneeling reach → low crawl into lying arch (~0:36–0:44) → rise (~0:45) → wide traveling triangle (~0:48–1:05) → 1:06 the music opens — run with acro (~1:06–1:16) · 1:12 breath · 1:36 final push to the end · 2:13 music gone — hold until 2:24
strengths: Straight vertical leg with a pointed foot in the floor phrase
Deep lunge + arm reach (~0:57) is her best line
Dances the traveling section full size
corrections: Match the leg height the three agree on — three heights reads as three pictures
Count the rolls out loud (she was a beat behind at ~0:21)
Arms in second: at or above shoulder, long elbows
Forward folds hinge at the hips, not through the back
Eyelines agree with the other two in the standing section
#timing Hold the final picture through the silence to 2:24 — count 11 slow seconds
notes: Larisa, Oct 14: run it and make “what comes next” automatic — that is the best thing they can do for themselves right now. Knowing the routine firmly comes before working on HOW to execute. Back in the studio with them in a couple of weeks.

cues.move: Floor phrase — all three legs up, one height
Low crawl into lying arch — don't rush the float
Rise — eyes meet Hannah and Lauren
Music opens — run with acro, crisp on the hits

story: The world is loud. You, Hannah and Lauren are safe together without a word.
performance: Story: words cause hurt and noise; Sofia, Hannah and Lauren have built a quiet, safe bubble. Connection without words is the point.
Face — sharp, heavy lines: intense, guarded or reaching, as if the noise is intruding.
Face — chorus: soften jaw and forehead, let out a gentle breath — relief, warmth, trust.
Connection: lock eyes with Hannah and Lauren to say 'I've got your back'. Inhale together on lifts, exhale on melts — one heartbeat.
Musicality: hits and catches sudden and crisp on the sharp beats. When the piano floats, don't rush — stillness is as strong as a leap.
Golden tip: every time the chorus comes back, show how much comfort and strength the three of you give each other without speaking.
Ending: the music is gone for the last 11 seconds (2:13–2:24). Three bodies still, three faces still, breathing together — the judges are still watching.

name: PITCH · Jazz group · Groove Is in the Heart

music: 2:31 cut at about 123 BPM, so one 8-count is about 3.9 seconds (roughly 38 eights total). Quiet intro 0:00–0:08 · builds 0:08–0:24 · full groove 0:24–1:12 · breakdown/dip 1:12–1:20 · full groove 1:20–1:48 · BIG DROP-OUT 1:52–1:56 (almost silent — a hit or freeze lives here) · final push 1:56–2:26 · tail to 2:31.
map: 0:08 first energy jump · 0:24 groove locks in · 1:12 breakdown · 1:52 the silence (hold it!) · 1:56 last section starts · 2:26 ending
corrections: Jazz is about sharp accents: hit and stop on the beat, no melting between shapes
Match the biggest dancer's size on every travel step
Freeze completely in the 1:52 silence — any wobble shows
